'''Vadlerio''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who worked as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] in the [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was controlled by the Republic. Vadlerio had [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and tanned skin. While at his stall he wore white and grey [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vadlerio first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' which was released in [[2011]] by [[BioWare]]. In the game he serves as a Republic cantina vendor on Corellia.
